claims: April 3, 2026 is not a federal holiday in the United States.
Good Friday is a state holiday in some areas.
The next federal holiday after April 3, 2026 is Memorial Day on Monday, May 25, 2026.
The U.S. Postal Service (USPS) is open on April 3, 2026.
Federal offices are open on April 3, 2026.
The stock market is closed on April 3, 2026.
